interface.longDescription: Community skills for iPhone Duo, Apple's two-display folding iPhone. Covers what makes it different from an iPad, layout across the outer and inner displays, the fold and device poses, a two-page book layout, vertical bars, design references from shipped apps, pose-by-pose design review and simulator testing. Not an official Apple, OpenAI or Anthropic plugin. No bundled hooks or servers. Sources and licences are recorded in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
